title: Outdoor Adventures
intro: Outdoor Adventures hosts a variety of recreational activities including Unit Recreation, Youth Summer Camps, Kayak Tours, Archery events and more! We also offer outdoor facility rentals such as Hospital Point Picnic Area and Orde Pond Picnic Area as well as 7 primitive campsites at our Brewster Recreation Area.

sections.heading: Customer Entrance & Parking
sections.markdown:
Due to construction, West Road is closed. Customers visiting Recreational Equipment Checkout & Rentals and Outdoor Adventures should:
- Use the customer entrance on Ash Street
- For Event Parking: Park in the SNCO Thrift Store parking lot to access Building 1108

sections.heading: Unit Recreation
sections.markdown:
**Did you know we have Unit Recreation/PT Alternative?**

**Monday-Friday**

**7:30AM | 9:30AM | 11:30AM**

(Additional times may be requested)

Each activity is designed to assist with building resiliency, unit cohesion, morale, teamwork, physical fitness, and communication. Customize your outdoor experience by calling today.

1. ONLY open to Active Duty unit groups
2. For best service (though not a requirement), reservations should be made at least one weeks in advance
3. Requests are confirmed via email and are finalized upon receipt of upfront and minimum fee
4. Minimum group size is 10 participants
5. The upfront down payment is $50 for Unit Packages (covers the first 10 participants)
6. $5 fee for each additional participant
7. No discounts for groups smaller than 10
8. Participant maximums vary by activity
9. A blanket Hold Harmless Waiver and a Gear Use Agreement will be on site for your group to sign before the event
10. Music devices are discouraged

**Call 910-451-1368 to register.**

sections.heading: Unit Mountain Biking
sections.markdown:
If you are a leader and are looking for a perfect team building activity or alternative to running, this is it.

This is the most Challenging and REWARDING UNIT PT offering on all of Camp Lejeune. A staff member will meet your group with all the bikes and equipment necessary for this activity. Work those muscles you never knew you had!

**Cost**
- Down Payment: $50.00 (covers first 10 people)
- Additional Participants: $5 per person

**Details**
- Location: Big Branch Trail, 261 NW Corridor Blvd, Jacksonville, NC 28540
- Length: 5.4 miles
- Difficulty: Moderately Strenuous
- Max of 30 Participants
- ODA brings the bikes to the trail
- Drinking water is not available
- No water bottle cages on bikes, bring a hydration pack or backpack for a bottle

sections.heading: Unit Kayaking
sections.markdown:
Enjoy the serenity of Wallace Creek and paddle with the jumping mullet and to the lucky group, dolphins! Race, work together, or enjoy a leisurely cruise. This kayak session will work on core strength, upper body muscles and endurance. Our friendly staff will meet you and equip you with a kayak or canoe, paddles, and a Personal Flotation Device.

**Cost**
- Down Payment: $50.00 (covers first 10 people)
- Additional Participants: $5 per person

**Details**
- Location: Gottschalk Marina, Camp Lejeune
- Duration: up to 1.5 hours
- Difficulty: Easy
- Max of 50 Participants
- Bring a hydration pack or water bottle, sunscreen, bug spray, a hat, sunglasses
- A change of clothes is recommended
- Custom paddling experiences may be available at your request

sections.heading: Unit Archery Tag
sections.markdown:
If you've enjoy archery, dodgeball, or are just plain competitive, Archery Tag® is for you! Played on a field set up similar to dodgeball, eliminate the other team by tagging them by hitting them with the patented foam tipped arrows from the Archery Tag® bows! This exciting, action-packed game offers the ultimate experience that engages everyone. Played with teams of 5 - 15 players, Archery Tag® may be played in a tournament or round robin format, with up to 4 teams playing on 2 courses at once. This is an excellent choice with the teambuilding goal in mind.

**Cost**
- Down Payment: $50.00 (covers first 10 people)
- Additional Participants: $5 per person

**Details**
- Location: This is a mobile event, there are several options for playing field and we can come to you!
- Duration: Up to 1.5 hours
- Difficulty: Easy/Competitive Sport
- Max 100 participants
- Bring your own water, sunscreen, and bug spray
- Rules and safety will be covered in a brief prior to the start

sections.heading: Unit GelBlaster Battle
sections.markdown:
Gel ball is a game similar to paintball or laser tag. This game is designed with the aim to provide the best real experience of firearms and it is mostly built with plastic. This is an excellent choice with the teambuilding goal in mind. Total of 30 Gel Blaster Surge Markers (guns), and each Marker comes with 800 Gellets® (ammo).

**Cost**
- Down Payment: $50.00 (covers first 10 people)
- Additional Participants: $5 per person

**Details**
- Location: This is a mobile event, there are several options for playing field and we can come to you!
- Duration: Up to 1.5 hours
- Difficulty: Easy/Competitive Sport
- Bring your own water, sunscreen, and bug spray
- Rules and safety will be covered in a brief prior to the start

sections.heading: Bounce & Play Party Package
sections.markdown:
Enjoy hours of fun where you can bounce, play, and celebrate with an all-in-one party package!

- 2 hours of bounce time
- 5 inflatables
- Max of 50 people total per party
- $300

Package includes indoor staging in our spacious facility on Camp Lejeune, so you can focus on the fun without worrying about the weather, set-up or clean-up! Plus, tables and chairs are provided for your guests. Bring your own food and supplies.

Contact us at 910-451-1368 to book your party today!

sections.heading: Brewster Campground
sections.markdown:
**Features**
- 6 primitive tent camping spaces
- 1 group campsite
- Canoe & kayak launch
- Potable water & port-a-john toilets
- Most of the campsites are equipped with a picnic shelter, picnic table, and fire ring.

**Reservations & Pricing**
- Reservations must be made at least 48 hours prior to date requested.
- Reservations aren't confirmed until payment is received. Payment may be made at the Outdoor Adventures Office.
- Single site (12 people): $15
- Group site (40 people): $30

**Check-in & Checkout**
- Check-in: after 12PM
- Check-out: before 11AM (On your own)

Please contact the Outdoor Recreation Office with your check-in time. If late checkout is needed, please make arrangements in advance.

**Rules & Regulations**
1. All individuals are to adhere to the Leave No Trace principles.
2. Pets must remain under the guest's control and in sight at all times.
3. Owners are responsible for their pet's behavior.
4. Please clean up after your pet at all times
5. Children under the age of 10 must be supervised at all times.
6. Quiet hours are between 10PM - 6AM. No excessive noise will be permitted at any time.

**Emergency Information**
- Base Emergency: 911
- Base Emergency Communication Center: 910.451.3004

**Fires**

Ground fires are allowed in the fire ring. Fires are ONLY permitted in assigned areas.

To have a fire at your campsite, you must have the following items on your site:
- Bucket of water (5 gallons)
- Rack or shovel

Fires ARE NOT permitted under the following conditions:
- If the National Weather Service issues a red flag for burning
- When the base is in a Class V Fire Condition

To verify fire conditions, visit https://www.ncagr.gov/divisions/nc-forest-service/fire-control-and-prevention/sit-report

sections.heading: Fishing
sections.markdown:
Marine Corps Base Camp Lejeune offers a variety of fishing opportunities for the hobbyist angler. Ocean front, inlet and fresh water areas are available for fishing. Information concerning these areas can be obtained from the facilities below:

- Gottschalk Marina: 910.451.8307
- Base Game Warden: 910.451.2196

**Rules of Conduct**
1. Always pick-up litter and deposit it in an approved trash receptacle.
2. Never spade or dig bait along shoreline that can lead to soil erosion.
3. Only use rowboats, canoes, or boats powered by electric trolling motors within the Base Ponds, to decrease the effect of pollution.

It is everyone's responsibility to ensure that our natural resources remain in good order for the next recreational fisherman to enjoy.

sections.heading: Fishing Ponds
sections.markdown:
Camp Lejeune currently maintains eight ponds, 46.5 acres total, which are managed by the Fish and Wildlife Section of the Environmental Management Division.

| Name | Acreage | Species* |
|---|---|---|
| Cedar Point Pond | 2.0 | BL, BA |
| Henderson Pond | 14.0 | BL, BA |
| Hickory Pond | 5.5 | BL, BA |
| Mile Hammock Bay Pond | 1.5 | BL, BA |
| Orde Pond | 3.0 | BL, BA |
| Ward Pond | 1.5 | BL, BA |
| Old Landfill Pond | 17.5 | BA, C |

\* BL= Bluegill, BA=Bass, C=Channel Catfish

sections.heading: Fishing Permits & Licenses
sections.markdown:
**Licenses** (Required for individuals 16 years or older)

Any individuals 16 years or older who want to recreationally fish in any water designated as coastal or joint waters of North Carolina must purchase a NC Coastal Recreational Fishing License (CRFL). Fishing licenses can be obtained at the New River Marina.

**Base Fishing Permits**

Current Base Order requires anyone over the age of 16 that wants to fish to have a NC state fishing license and a base fishing permit. Children under the age of 16 do not need a state fishing license nor a base fishing permit but must be accompanied by a parent or guardian.
